entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I need to return this useless VeloBand and your company is making it impossible! This is an absolute joke!
I'm very sorry to hear you're frustrated. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the return process?

The issue is your whole system is a joke! It was completely down! I tried to return this thing nine days after I got it, and your whole website was down! I got a massive website error message over and over. I couldn't print the stupid label. I'm 20 days in now and I'm not paying for your company's incompetence!

I understand your frustration with the website being unavailable. That sounds like a terrible experience. Let me just pull up your account information. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

It's angrycustomer@email.com. Look, just get me your manager. I've wasted enough time. I even have a screenshot of the error page! I'm about to post it all over social media about how you trap people into keeping your faulty products.

I appreciate you providing that. I can see your order here for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I understand you're upset, and I truly believe I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Let me just check our current return policy for you.
Okay, I've just reviewed the policy. It looks like you're well within the 90-day return window.
Wait, what? Ninety days? The website made it seem like I had ten minutes! Are you sure?

Yes, I'm looking at our knowledge base right now and all our items have a 90-day return period. I can absolutely process this return for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label immediately so you don't have to worry about the website at all.
Oh. Well... fine. As long as I'm getting my money back. Send the label.

Of course. I've just sent it to the email on file. You should see it within the next few minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
